mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a loss of investor confidence, reducing risk appetite and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 5.0% in the trigger period, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in demand (GDPC1) and decrease in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) when GDPC1 and INDPRO move in opposite directions as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust supply growth, reducing production bottlenecks and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers increased labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) when UNRATE drops below 4.0%, or t-test shows no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals tightening monetary policy coupled with labor market strength, which may reduce growth expectations and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p >0.05) despite the predicted policy tightening and labor strength, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, accommodative monetary policy (e.g., falling FEDFUNDS rates) is expected to boost equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals potential policy divergence, where rising inflation pressures may be met with delayed rate hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS fall simultaneously, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.
